text: OVERDOSAGE Neutrexin (trimetrexate glucuronate for injection) administered without concurrent leucovorin can cause lethal complications. There has been no extensive experience in humans receiving single intravenous doses of trimetrexate greater than 90 mg/m 2 /day with concurrent leucovorin. The toxicities seen at this dose were primarily hematologic. In the event of overdose, Neutrexin should be stopped and leucovorin should be administered at a dose of 40 mg/m 2 every 6 hours for 3 days. The LD 50 of intravenous trimetrexate in mice is 62 mg/kg (186 mg/m 2 ).
